source: trial-only list prices, recorded by hand
note: Anthropic's published price for claude-haiku-5-5, read on 2026-10-24 from the Claude API reference's model table (cached 2026-10-06): $0.10 in and $0.50 out per million tokens for prompts of up to 100,000 tokens, and $0.50 and $2.50 above that. These entries carry the lower rate, so a call whose prompt passes 100,000 tokens is under-priced; the runs report their largest prompt. The cached-input price is not recorded: the trial's calls send no cache breakpoints. Context (1,000,000 tokens) and maximum output (128,000) were read from the live Models API the same day.
